name: redis
description: Read and write a live Redis instance through the official redis-mcp-server — strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, JSON, streams, pub/sub, and vector search, against local, self-hosted, Redis Cloud, or Azure Managed Redis databases.

interface.shortDescription: Drive a Redis instance through the official redis-mcp-server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can work directly with your Redis databases — reading and writing keys, managing caches, publishing to channels, and handling queues. Whether you need to check cached values, inspect stream data, manage pub/sub channels, or run vector searches, your agent can do it through natural conversation. No more opening redis-cli for every operation.
defaultPrompt: Show me the keys and values stored in my Redis cache.
Help me inspect what's in this Redis stream or queue.
Check the memory usage and health of my Redis instance.
